title: The contact items as a group of their own in the reference manual of the items
author: Claude-JG
description: The reference manual lists the objects in the groups Body, SuperElement, FiniteElement, Joint, Connector, Constraint and Object; the contact items are listed among the connectors, now more than a dozen. Decided: a group Contact for the items of the contact type.
releaseNotes: The reference manual of the items lists the contacts as a group of their own, Object (Contact), with a general page on the data node, the active set and the Create functions.
